traits.name: Avernal Fever
traits.text: (disease); Saving Throw DC 23 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day) Stage 2 enfeebled 1 (1 day) Stage 3 enfeebled 2 (1 day)

traits.name: Infernal Wound
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); A bearded devil's glaive Strike also deals 1d6 (1d6) persistent bleed damage that resists attempts to heal it. The flat check to stop the bleeding starts at DC 20. The DC is reduced to 15 only if the bleeding creature or an ally successfully assists with the recovery. The DC to Administer First Aid to a creature with an infernal wound is increased by 5. A spellcaster or item attempting to use healing magic on a creature suffering from an infernal wound must succeed at a DC 21 counteract check or the magic fails to heal the creature.

traits.name: Reposition
traits.text: ⭓ Trigger The devil hits a creature with a glaive Strike. Effect The devil moves the creature 5 feet in any direction. The destination square must be within reach of the devil's glaive. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

traits.name: Wriggling Beard
traits.text: ⬻ Frequency once per round Effect The barbazu makes a beard Strike. This Strike ignores their multiple attack penalty and doesn't count toward that penalty.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ glaive +15 (deadly 1d8, evil, forceful, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 1d8+7 (1d8+7) slashing plus 2d6 (2d6) evil and infernal wound

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +15 (agile, evil, magical); Damage 2d6+7 (2d6+7) slashing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ beard +15 (magical); Damage 1d6+7 (1d6+7) piercing plus Avernal fever
